body_lead: Police in Madhya Pradesh are conducting pilot testing of artificial intelligence (AI) systems to simulate various scenarios and modernise their training modules, The Indian Express has learnt. The new training will encompass sophisticated small arms weapon simulators, AI-driven drill instruction systems, and advanced firing range training platforms specifically engineered to address the complex operational challenges faced by security personnel across different environments.
